thread:
incident-bot: Pager: KV cache OOM on hosted-runtime pool-12 — memory spike detected, affected shards: shard-7, shard-9. Auto-scaling failed; prefetched KV windows ballooning due to long prompts. Alert severity: P1.
eng-oncall-aaron: Acked. Pulling logs and attaching heap snapshots. @maya @jake please triage.
maya: Seeing sustained KV keys per-session jump from ~120 -> ~3.2k in 2m for model: redwood-open-13b. Long prompts + repeated system messages.
maya: Example request ids: r-8f3a, r-8f3b, r-8f3c. Prefetch depth blew past guardrails.
eng-oncall-aaron: Is customer-facing traffic spike? support-lead-lina?
support-lead-lina: Checking. Support telemetry shows 6 customers saw increased 500s; 2 heavy users (acct-984, acct-112). Notified downstream CS.
jake: Runtime metrics: continuous-batching window increased from 32ms -> 512ms under load due to backpressure; batch size jumped and kvmap grew. KV heap full -> OOM on process PID 24567.
eng-oncall-aaron: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary prefetch cap, 2) throttle batching windows, 3) evict large session keys for long prompts. Executing step 1 now.
ops-sara: Applying prefetch cap on pool-12: `redwoodctl runtime update --pool pool-12 --kvcache.prefetch.max_keys=200 --kvcache.prefetch.enabled=true`
ops-sara: Patch applied. Confirming accept rate drop.
maya: Prefetch cap reduced KV growth rate by ~70% on shard-7 within 60s. Memory pressure falling.
jake: Next apply batch window limit to avoid runaway continuous batching. Pushing hotpatch: `rbctl set service runtime.pool-12.batch.window_ms=64`
eng-oncall-aaron: Hotpatch rolled to all nodes in pool-12 (canary 20% -> 100%). Watching for error spike.
incident-bot: Deploy event: runtime.batch.window_ms set to 64ms by jake at 2024-11-02T15:29:30Z.
support-lead-lina: Customer impact: acct-984 saw 5 min outage, automated retries masked issues for others. Opening incident emails for affected customers.
maya: Also evicted top-5 longest sessions older than 30m as stopgap: `kvcache evict --pool pool-12 --criteria age>1800 --limit 5`
jake: We observed a secondary perf cliff in shard-9 due to kvmap pagewalks — triggered a restart of process 24567 after eviction. Restart succeeded, no new OOMs for 10m.
eng-oncall-aaron: On-call handoff note: @jake you own the live mitigation for next 2h, I'll rotate to follow-up/comms.
jake: Got it. I'll put a short runbook in #incidents after stable.
ops-sara: Added temporary autoscale cushion + disabled aggressive prefetch rollout in prod region us-west-2.
support-lead-lina: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating memory OOMs causing intermittent 500s for sessions with extremely long prompts. Mitigations applied; performance stabilizing. We'll follow up with root cause and long-term fix." Will send once operations confirm stability.
maya: Filing tickets: INC-4728 (hotpatch follow-up), INC-4729 (kvcache eviction policy), INC-4730 (batching controller backpressure).
incident-bot: Pager closed by eng-oncall-aaron at 2024-11-02T15:45:11Z.
jake: Leaving logs and gist: https://internal.gists/redwood/incident-1771234567 (heap snapshots, flamegraphs). :thumbsup:
eng-oncall-aaron: Postmortem assigned, will include customer impact timeline and rollout of prefetch guardrails. Thanks all for quick responses.
